changes:
Aurora's feed-forward speaker protection (speakerguardd 0.1) for the MacBook Neo (J700), built as alarm-aurora builds it: the unit names only the J700 model, and speakersafetyd stands down on the J700.
The legacy speaker protection (speakersafetyd, speakerguardd 0.1) is deprecated and will be removed; speakerguardd v2 is opt in through aurora-speaker-upgrade, and the description says so.
notes: The build fetches the crates Cargo.lock pins from crates.io (cargo --locked), as alarm-aurora's build does, and uses Debian's Rust toolchain.
